# Skeleton (`skeleton`)

Shimmering placeholders while loading.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSkeleton` (types in `dist/web/feedback/skeleton.d.ts`): `.mh-skeleton--text | --block | --circle`: shimmering placeholders while content loads. The root is a busy status (`role="status"`, `aria-busy`); the shapes inside (`__line`, `__shape`) are hidden from assistive technology.

```ts
export function createSkeleton(options: SkeletonOptions = {}):;

export interface SkeletonOptions {
  shape?: SkeletonShape;
  /** Text: number of lines (default 3; the last one is shorter). */
  lines?: number;
  /** Any CSS length for `block` and `circle` (default: full width, one large control high). */
  width?: string;
  height?: string;
  /** Read by screen readers (default "Loading"). */
  label?: string;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSkeleton, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const card = h('div', { 'aria-live': 'polite' }, createSkeleton({ lines: 3, label: 'Loading the forecast' }).el);

// Swap the placeholder for the content once it has loaded.
setTimeout(() => {
  card.replaceChildren(
    h('h3', {}, 'Tomorrow'),
    h('p', {}, 'Light rain in the morning, clearing by noon.'),
    h('p', {}, 'High of 17°, low of 9°.'),
  );
}, 1500);

document.body.append(card);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Skeleton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SkeletonExample() {
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setLoaded(true), 1500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  if (!loaded) return <Skeleton lines={3} label="Loading the forecast" />;
  return (
    <div>
      <h3>Tomorrow</h3>
      <p>Light rain in the morning, clearing by noon.</p>
      <p>High of 17°, low of 9°.</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
